glosses: Resembling or shaped like a star.

examples.text: I shrank from the starry waters as they rose to my lip, but a power stronger than my will compelled me to their taste.

glosses: Full of stars or celebrities.

examples.text: Despite a starry cast, the film performed poorly at the box office.
